mechanism_card.hypothesis: Removing R0 dots inside the strike-aligned cross-strike collar (|across|<=5 px = 500 m, |along|<=0.5 px = 50 m; isotropic fallback where coherence<0.3) strips mapped-fault scarp haloes while preserving along-strike tip continuations beyond 0.5 px, AND refilling the exact 1333 removed dots via 5 km block-stratified exact R=3 px marginal-kernel infill (q50, d_cat>=3.0 px) eliminates the IR90-35 northern-strip concentration (y<=101) and IR90-12 kernel-shadow waste of anisoA5L0p5.
mechanism_card.mechanism: At fixed count S=37,654 (dS=0), collar pruning removes 1333 cross-strike flank dots (median |across|=2.98 px). Instead of global FIFO-BFS refill (anisoA5L0p5, which dumped 100% of 1333 dots into northern rows y in [0, 101], starving 822/848 dense 5 km blocks and placing 97.6% within 3 px of retained dots at median 1.00 px), q50 allocates block quotas across all 1,788 R0-occupied 5 km blocks (1124/1,788 receiving additions, 0/848 dense blocks starved, addition_evenness_gate=True) and greedily selects H19-5 cells at d_cat>=3.0 px that maximize exact R=3 px marginal kernel gain. Off-catalogue H19-5 support credit recovered by refill rises from +655.7 (anisoA5L0p5) to +1504.8 (anisoA5L0p5q50, 2.30x), and net outside-collar H19-5 coverage shifts from -237.5 to +432.8 while cutting median replacement distance from 898.3 px to 17.3 px.
mechanism_card.non_fault_confounder: 100 m DEM hillshade/slope edges parallel to mapped Quaternary fault scarps, piedmont bajada fan-head trenches, and erosional terrace risers within <=500 m across strike of catalogue traces (which trigger H19-5 without an independent unmapped fault), plus mid-strand H19-5 ridge segments on volcanic flow margins or lithologic contacts outside the collar where q50 refills land.
